sample_size_calculation.value: Currently, there is a lack of studies on the impact of mechanical ventilation approaches on Cpa guided by Ptp. For this pathophysiological study, the sample size to evaluate the impact of Ptp on respiratory compliance was around 60 cases, based on previous literature (12). This study was considered to be exploratory pathophysiological research and based on the actual number of eligible cases available at our center and the research duration, we confirmed a required sample size of 20 patients in each of the two groups.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_subgroup: all enrolled patients met the Berlin ARDS definition (inclusion criterion) and all had pneumonia-induced ARDS. obesity_subgroup: mean BMI 25.3 ± 2.8 (Ptp) and 24.5 ± 3.5 (control), both well below 30 kg/m2. timing_subgroup: eligibility required invasive mechanical ventilation for less than 72 hours before enrolment, so balloon-guided management started somewhere between 0 and 72 hours from intubation, i.e. the population spans the 48-hour cut; exact interval not reported, and time from illness onset to ICU admission was 8 (7-13) days in the Ptp group. ptp_target_subgroups: PEEP was titrated to an end-expiratory Ptp of 0-5 cm H2O (a positive end-expiratory range) with an end-inspiratory Ptp ceiling of 25 cm H2O; the computation method for Ptp is not stated in the paper. is_longest_reported_mortality: only ICU mortality is reported, so it is the longest available follow-up mortality, per the ruling preferring the reported (discharge-based) outcome when no fixed-day alternative exists.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md lists no cluster that includes tang_2026. Registration checked: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT 05629832, registration date November 14, 2022 - does not match any listed cluster (epvent1 NCT00127491, epvent2, DRKS00017449 for the Mannheim/Boesing reports, NCT02105220/NCT02503241 for the MGH reports, and the separate Angers studies). Enrolment dates checked: January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2024 - outside the enrolment windows of all listed clusters. Centres checked: single centre, respiratory ICU of Beijing Chao-Yang Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China - no shared centre with any listed cluster. The paper cites Talmor 2008 (ref 18) and Beitler 2019 / Sarge 2021 (refs 19-20) only as background literature. Conclusion: no cohort overlap; this is a unique cohort and its own primary report.
unclear_items: design.enrolment_end: the Results text states 'From January 1, 2023, to December 31, 2024, a total of 195 patients diagnosed with pneumonia-induced ARDS were admitted', but the Figure 1 flowchart states 'From January 1st, 2023, to April 30th, 2023, total 151 patients pneumonia induced ARDS admission to RICU'. The two enrolment windows conflict; the text dates were recorded and the discrepancy was not resolvable.

population.n_vasopressors: the Results text says 'Twenty patients received a norepinephrine infusion during the study' while Table 1 gives Norepinephrine n (%) of 9 (45) in the Ptp group and 12 (60) in the control group, which sums to 21 of 40. The stated text value (20) was recorded; the discrepancy is unresolved.

intervention.ptp_computation.method: the paper reports Ptp targets (expiratory Ptp 0-5 cm H2O; inspiratory Ptp <25 cm H2O) but never states how Ptp was computed. Coded not_reported; an absolute Pes subtraction (Paw - Pes) is implied but not printed, so method_verbatim could not be quoted.

intervention.balloon_calibration: only 'occlusion technique was used to confirm the appropriate balloon location' is reported; no balloon filling volume, no pressure-volume filling curve and no occlusion-ratio acceptance threshold are given. Coded signal_quality_verification_only because the occlusion manoeuvre is described as a location/validity check, but the sentence could equally be read as a Baydur/dynamic occlusion calibration test.

population.baseline_by_arm.sex_female: the paper reports only 'Gender (male), n (%)' (14 (70) in each group). Female counts were not derived (codebook rule against deriving one sex from the other); the male counts are recorded in population.additional_baseline if needed.

outcomes Cpa (72 hr): the Results text attributes p = 0.039 to the between-group comparison, whereas Figure 2A lists P0 (group interaction trend) = 0.039 and P1 (intergroup difference) = 0.252. The figure footnote defines P0 = group interaction trend and P1 = intergroup difference. The text value was recorded as the effect estimate; the P values printed inside the figure panels were difficult to read in the rendered page.

feasibility.n_placement_attempted / n_placement_successful: no counts of esophageal balloon placement attempts, failures or unusable signals are reported, although all 20 patients randomised to the Ptp group were analysed.
intervention.duration_of_pes_guidance: the duration over which the Ptp-guided strategy was applied is not stated; monitoring durations are 72 hr (PAC) and 5 days (TTE).
data_only_in_figure: Right ventricular ejection fraction (RVEF) over 72 hr (Fig. 2B)
Tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion (TAPSE) over 5 days (Fig. 3B)
extraction_flags.general_notes: Single-centre, unblinded (outcome assessment and statisticians blinded) randomised parallel-arm pilot study of Ptp-guided PEEP titration versus the ARDSNet lower PEEP/FiO2 table, n=20 per arm, pneumonia-induced ARDS, Beijing, China, 2023-2024. The primary endpoint is a dynamic (72-hr, repeated-measures) comparison of pulmonary arterial compliance, not a clinical outcome; clinical outcomes reported are ICU mortality, IMV duration and ICU duration. Baseline between-group p values printed in Tables 1-3 were not transcribed as effect_estimates (they are baseline comparability tests rather than outcome contrasts); only the p values for the three clinical outcome rows and for the serial/interaction comparisons were entered. Table 1 also reports pathogen (Aspergillus, Pneumocystis jirovecii, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus pyogenes, Chlamydia psittaci) and comorbidity (coronary heart disease, chronic heart failure, chronic kidney failure, immunosuppression, solid organ malignant tumour, solid organ transplantation, pleural effusion, acute liver dysfunction, acute heart dysfunction) rows that were not transcribed individually into population.additional_baseline. The Pao2/Fio2 and respiratory-system compliance trajectories over 72 hr are reported only as 'no significant difference in the trend' with no numeric estimate and are therefore not entered as outcome entries. Hospital length of stay is named as a secondary endpoint but no data are reported. Figure 2/3 panel-level P values (P0-P3) are printed only inside the figures.
